items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Sal Nistico and Curtis Peagler and them boys you know, I can’t think because I’ll leave it, the guy’s name — you know but them guys can play you know.

ctx.x: Jelly Roll Morton and those people.

Yes and all those people and they come on up then they get the bebop days you know, pre-bebop you know. But I’m telling you, Nat King Cole, Sammy Davis Junior, Miles Davis, even Sinatra, Tony Bennett, but we’re focusing on the black ones and, you know, Dexter Gordon and Doug Carn and all the rest, we’re on that same tree we’re just another jigaboo we’re just a higher level of fruit of the same tree is the way they look at it, you know? And that you know so at any given night they say, “[inaudible] What are we…

up with ‘All the Things You Are” now. And in New York Dexter Gordon kicks it off you know, they’re all playing the same tune, drinking the same whiskey, you know, eating the same steaks, you know, competing for the same dollar you know. And they say, “Yeah, man, but them guys in a big band in Vegas, Reno and Tahoe, they can’t play like the cats can.” I said, “The hell they can’t” you know. You don’t know what you’re talking about.
